notes.title: Fox Plush now available and update on the game
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders, 

It's out! The Three Tailed Fox Plush from Epistory is now available on [url=https://shop.makeship.com/3ucFrod]Makeship[/url]. We now have 21 days to reach the minimum funding goal of 200 pre-orders to launch the production. The Epistory plush is a limited edition so it won't be possible to find it after the campaign. Don't miss it out! Once the product is ready, we ship it directly to you.

notes.title: Some news about Epistory and Nanotale
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders, 

We hope that you are doing well. Here, we entered a second lockdown which means that our team is working from home for 7 months now. 

[h2]An update on Epistory[/h2]

First of all, thank you for being such a wonderful community, and for all the reviews left on the game page. These reviews are probably one of the reasons why Epistory is still popular in 2020. ːepipartyː

Since the release of Epistory, we compiled a list of minor bugs reported by the community. Now that Nanotale (our new typing game) is about to be finished, our amazing programmer will take some time to fix these remaining bugs and update Epistory. 

That's it for Epistory. Thank you again for the nice reviews. ːepiloveː


[h2]News about Nanotale[/h2]

For the Fox Riders who don't know about it, Nanotale is our new typing game based on a survey we ran amongst Epistory's players. The game is different from Epistory since we didn't want to do an Epistory 2 but a totally new typing experience. 

The game was released on Steam early access on October 2019. Most of the players are returning Fox Riders who wants to help us while the game is still in development by reporting bug and giving us feedback/suggestions. But we also had the pleasure to welcome new players who never played a typing game before. 

The current content of the game represents 75% of the experience with 2 out of 3 biomes accessible at the moment. We are now finishing the last biome that will be available in Closed BETA by the end of the year. So players who already own the game, won't have to wait until the final release to complete it. Meanwhile, we'll continue to polish and improve game until we release it in early 2021. 

Here are few screenshots showing you Nanotale and its current state. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10168702/237acd7fe2fd68f5cbb129e7d0aa36053b6c8d5d.png[/img]

That's it guys! Thank you for reading. 

Cheers,
-VirginRedemption

notes.title: Nanotale is now available!
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders,

We are honored to welcome you to the Order. You are now ready to be an Archivist from Nanotale and to venture alone in the Ancestral Forest to unveil its secrets.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/VI9BTSuCFua23rABqF/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Buy the game now and encourage the development.[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/944920/Nanotale__Typing_Chronicles/

We hope that you will enjoy your time during early access. Don't hesitate to help us improve the game by giving us feedback end reporting bugs in the following steam discussions.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/944920/discussions/3/]FAQ[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/944920/discussions/1/]Suggestion and Feedback[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/944920/discussions/2/]Bugs and Technical Issues[/url]

[b]Leaving us a review will also help us a lot [/b]during the rest of the development and increase visibility on the game.


[h1]What can you expect from the current version ?[/h1]
The game features around 2-4 hours of gameplay depending on your skills and willingness to explore its content. 

We consider art direction as final and core game mechanics are in place. 

As an Early Access version, we are aware there are both major and minor bugs in the build.

Our priority in the following days and weeks will be to make sure those bugs are ironed out and you can experience the game up to its end. As of today, the build is solid but in edge cases, blockers can be found. Also expect quite a few updates on Steam. 


[h1]What we plan to improve from here?[/h1]
As an Early Access version, we know things are not perfect and we already have a lot planned on our side until final release. Here is an overview of what we plan to do.

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list][*] Add new powers
[*] Tweak current powers
[*] Tweak upgrade system
[*] Improve arena battles (visibility, spawn, feedback)
[*] Quests system
[/list]
[b]ART[/b]
[list][*] Fix invisible collision issues
[*] Improve overall juiciness of the game
[*] Improve character animations and transitions (NPCs, main character)
[*] Refine the Fox FX
[*] Work on transitions
[*] Work on cameras
[*] Add new FXs
[/list]
[b]UI/UX[/b]
[list][*] Many improvements to be made on menus
[/list]
[b]COMBAT[/b]
[list][*] Integrate adaptive difficulty
[*] Tweak speed, damage and behaviors of enemies
[/list]
[b]MAP[/b]
[list][*] Make the gameplay elements on the 2D map more visible
[*] Work on the level design to make paths and understanding of levels clearer
[/list]
[b]CONTENT[/b]
[list][*] 2 more biomes each featuring their own unique environment
[*] Complementary powers
[*] More NPCs and villages
[/list]
[b]MUSIC/SFX[/b]
[list][*] Add new and more variety to current SFXs
[*] Add new and more music themes
[/list]
[b]STORY[/b]
[list][*] Initial and prologue to the story (why and how Rosalind gets in the world)
[*] Intro / Cinematics
[*] Voice Over
[*] Tweaks texts and dialogues
[/list]

Thank you very much for the love and support guys! 

-VirginRedemption and the rest of the team

notes.title: Weekly Recap #7: Rosalind's new shape and NPCs
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders, 

Following your feedback, we modified a little bit the shape of Rosalind. The new shape will also facilitate the creation of a low poly 3D version. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/454a3d28ecb5232d99607a905935cea8aab4deed.jpg[/img]

Here's a work in progress sculpt of Rosalind based on the new shape.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/841ba86d69f846173f6b7cb57a986b16b1ee4622.jpg[/img]

[h1]NPCs[/h1]
We did some color tests for the NPCs from the Ancestral Forest. A lot of you voted on Twitter, Facebook and Discord for the white, and the blue/green outfits.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/bc6c52732b77eeaebb72a764deca90e44c673143.jpg[/img]

So, we decided to keep both of them and create different kind of outfits for the NPCs. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/7b34fc065700c86d9eb53917e191c9765e66b863.png[/img]

[h1]Enemies[/h1]
A bit of work has also been done on a 3D modeling and color test for the RATS! How would you feel in front of an army of these running after you in the Ancestral Forest? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/6da15b0a9dcc2b8fb03380bb19eb2bac528c2332.jpg[/img]

[h1]T-shirts[/h1]
We would like to create a nice t-shirt to wear at PAX East and EGX Rezzed. These t-shirts will also be used for contest and giveaways :epiwink:

So, my question is: what would you like to see on it? Be creative and tell us what you'd like to wear. The girl, the Fox, a landscape, anything else? 

Thank you for reading. 

-VirginRedemption

PS: you liked the news? Read more of them on Nanotale's page
https://steamcommunity.com/app/944920/allnews/

notes.title: Do you hear what I hear? New update!
notes.content:
Hi Reindeer Riders,

We wanted to give you something special for Christmas. Of course, for those of you who don't own the game yet, the best present will be the discount during the Winter Sales. But for the others, we chose something that sounds less like buying and more like sharing. 

You’ve probably noticed that our main menu has a kind of Christmas feeling, so has one of our [b]Arenas[/b]. But the major update for this holiday season is the [b]Japanese language fully implemented in the game[/b]. As usual, don’t hesitate to tell us if you find typos or weird translations.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4JyNDMHtA9cxlg6A/source.gif[/img]

Also, IndieDB will announce the [b]Indie of the Year[/b] in 5 days. Epistory has the chance to be part of top 100. [url=http://www.indiedb.com/groups/2016-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote40141][b]Don’t hesitate to vote for us[/b][/url] if you feel like the game should win. We’ll add that there’s no need to be logged to vote. 

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/epistory]
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/groups/1/26/25073/profile/ioty-250.png[/img][/url]

To finish, every year for Christmas, we run a 48h internal Game Jam and this year we wanted to share the crazy and unfinished projects from previous years with our community. You can find and download the games [url=http://www.fishingcactus.com/cactusjam/]here[/url]. 


Have a wonderful Holiday Season!

notes.title: Let's celebrate the Tokyo Game Show!
notes.content:
Good news everyone!

On the occasion of the TGS, we took some time add the Japanese language to the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/389473311c1ee9469a1ab21fae062367f65443c5.png[/img]

Well, it's ready-ish. It's still a bit rough around the edges (one rarely-used font missing, a few minor bugs) so it is only available in a separate branch for now.

More importantly, since we only have a basic understanding of how the language works (thanks Wikipedia), we'll need your help to ensure it's readable and enjoyable.

The biggest change required was the dictionary system. Don't panic, the few mods already existing won't require any changes but since we had to support "dual words" for Japanese, we could also support the same kind of dual display for other languages. Let us know if we should spend the time to make it possible for someone to create his/her dictionary of "english & french displayed side by side"

If you want to try it here's a small guide to branch switching:
- In your steam library, right click on Epistory and then click on Properties.
- Go to the tab called "betas"
- Change the drop down to "japanese-beta".

Known bugs:
- One font missing (you'll see red XXXXX instead of words)
- "Companion word" (the one showing the translation) displayed for too long on some items.
- "Companion word" displayed for no good reason (e.g. on number chests)
- Gameplay language in the options not translated when set to "Japanese"

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: A demo for Epistory, and a promotion to celebrate it!
notes.content:
[h1]WIN A KEY WITH THE DEMO?[/h1]

We created a free demo of the game for those who are not yet convinced of the game potential. We promise you'll be hooked! And you now what? Complete the demo, choose wisely [b]and try to win a Steam key unlocking the full game[/b]. Not everyone will win but only those who dare win!

And fear not, the demo is a bit different from the full game so if you liked the game, starting over in the full game will stay fresh.


[h1]UPDATE ON STEAM![/h1]

Alongside the demo comes a small update on the game fixing several little bugs and now including the Czech language. During the whole Gamescom we had a discount on the game, if you missed it, we currently have a -35% discount on Steam (today only).

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
We just pushed the new version of the game. No new features, just a bunch of fixes for the most recent bugs.

Fixed:
- "Blue void" save error. Most, if not all, of you who were affected had slightly different symptoms but we believe the root cause was the same for everyone. It is now fixed but unfortunately the saves are not always compatible/retrievable. If you still have problems starting the game, either reset the saves or send us the corrupted save files and we will [i]try[/i] our best to fix them. 
- Crash at launch on Linux.
- (Silent) Errors when deleting the last profile
- Various small details

That's all for today.

notes.title: Version 1.2 is here!
notes.content:
After weeks of hard work, we present to you the new and shinier version of Epistory. You spoke and we listened. We understand it would have been better for most of you to receive the update in chunks over the weeks but given the amount of changes it was a lot easier for us to handle one big transition to the new version instead of several small incremental versions. We even had to stop planning for a workshop beta.
Without further ado, here’s the changelist:

Added/Improved
[list]
[*]Mod support.
[*]Profiles (multiple saves) support.
[*]Steam Cloud support.
[*]Distinction between gameplay and story language.
[*]Splash screen only when the game launches.
[*]Removed mouse cursor during gameplay.
[*]Improved arena wave randomness.
[*]Single letter words always get typed, even in the middle of another word.
[*]Several small improvements for the map.
[*](slightly) Improved performance, (massively) reduced spikes.
[*]V-Sync option.
[*]Custom mouse cursor.
[/list]
Fixed
[list]
[*]Several sound errors. Please let us know if you still encounter any problems.
[*]Game not loading on Linux when the OS is not set to English locale.
[*]Several small bugs for the map.
[*]Several small errors in the story texts.
[*]Several keyboard specific patterns.
[*]Music/effects volume preference not always respected.
[*]Entering the “Ice Mausoleum” door without triggering the scene change.
[/list]

And of course several small improvements/fixes across the board that would be too long to list. As always, we welcome your feedback and bug reports.

notes.title: New version is out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We fixed another slew of bugs:

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed the uncommon save issue after a power outage or system crash.
[*]Fixed the map in the 5th dungeon.
[*]Fixed the infinite level-up bug.
[*]Fixed the stats not being reset along with the game's progress.
[*]Fixed the chest staying locked in some cases in the 6th dungeon
[*]Fixed several misplayed sfx.
[/list]

Other changes:
[list]
[*]Harder arenas. It should not drastically change the points in the leaderboards but will make the later stages harder to avoid becoming an endurance contest.
[*]Torches and statues now become easier each time you fail.
[*]Music will calm down during the death sequence (both in arenas & in game)
[/list]

That's it for now, have a great day/evening/morning/night.

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
Good news everyone,

We have pushed a new update which fixes several issues with the game and adds some requested improvements.

Since we did some changes in the way we calculate the scores of the arena, we had to reset the leaderboards.

Here's the list.
[list]
[*]Added easier and harder difficulty levels
[*]Added move control with arrow keys
[*]Added JCUKEN (Russian) and QGMLWY dictionaries
[*]Sound FX volume tweak
[*]Highest combo count is not locked at 16 anymore
[*]Fixed chest achievement
[*]Fixed player sometimes getting stuck after a camera travelling
[*]Various bug fix in game
[*]Various bug fix in arena
[*]Added 2 new arenas
[/list]

We still have some known bugs:

- The uncommon save issue after a power outage or system crash will come at a later (not too distant) date, as it needs more testing.
- The arena leaderboard can be a bit finicky if you don't let the menu load all the scores.
- The map in the 5th dungeon is not always displayed correctly.

Have a great week end.

notes.title: Chapter 2 - Update 1 Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We hope you are enjoying the new chapter of the game. Since the update, we were busy fixing bugs and continuing work on the next chapter. Thanks to everyone pitching in to help us spot some of these.

Here's a (partial) list of what's changed:

Changed: Quit button in pause menu returns to main menu.

Fixed: Sound was played on the wrong device, even when said device was deactivated. Also known as "There's no sound".
Fixed: The ice door leading to the 4th dungeon was allowing access before the end of the animation.
Fixed: inspiration numbers were not always rounded.
Fixed: console (F1 for the curious among you) was spamming error when starting the arena after a normal game.
Fixed: The texts displayed during a combat were not hidden when you lose the battle.

Other: Small performance improvement.

We also have a list of known bugs that didn't make it into this update:

- Mac version not always having a successful install.
- If a crash/power loss occurs during loading time the save will be corrupted.

The rest of it concerns the next chapter so hush... spoilers...

Have a nice day/week end/steam sales and a happy Thanksgiving!

notes.title: Trick or Treat! Halloween Update
notes.content:
As promised, Epistory - Typing Chronicles is now available on [b]Linux[/b] and [b]Mac[/b]! If you encounter any bugs please give us a heads up and we’ll fix them as soon as possible. 

The challengers amongst you will be pleased to find the [b]new “Arena” mode[/b] in the main menu. It’s a special place where the world will finally recognize the value of your typing skills. We’re still working on the leaderboard that should come soon. It’s also a bit rough around the edges.

Note that [b]Spanish[/b] language has been added to the game. More languages to come during the Early Access. 

[img=http://blog.fishingcactus.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/screenshot_halloween_mac_linux3.jpg]

Here's the patch note for the new version: 
 
[b]New Features[/b]
Added: Infinite Battle “Arena” mode, where you’ll soon be able to challenge yourself and get your name at the top of the leaderboard. 
Added: Linux version
Added: Mac version
Added: Spanish version
And plenty of stuff behind the scene for the upcoming Chapter 2...

[b]Various improvements[/b]
Removed magic effect on enemies' last word.
Special characters are displayed when the required magic is locked.
Reworked “Burning Hollow” level design.
Reworked story in “Forgotten Forest“.

[b]Bug fix[/b]
Fixed: typing the word while it moves result in some letters not colored properly.
Fixed: avatar moving using the last letter of a word typed if the typing mode auto switch is triggered.
Fixed: auto typing mode switch was not happening if an untypeable (fire) word was displayed
Fixed: brambles were reorienting upon hit
And a lot more.


[b]Happy Halloween to all![/b]

Fixed: brambles were reorienting upon hit
